anya: Quick rollout notes from today's cross-region perf run comparing L4 / T4 / A10G for embeddings and our small-chat prompt set. Ran 3 quant configs: fp16, int8, int4 (post-train).
ben: Nice — which regions?
anya: us-west1, eu-west1, ap-southeast1. 90% of requests were 512-token embed-ish workloads and 128-token small-chat.
dmitri: Did you use the new kernel selector? cuBLAS default vs triton-optimized?
anya: Yes — test matrix: (1) baseline cuBLAS fp16, (2) triton fused-attn + cutlass for int8, (3) fallback generic kernels for int4. Kernel selection toggled via --kernel-policy in run script.
ml-bench-bot: run 1718012345: jobs=9, seeds=3, duration=20m, logs=/mnt/bench/1718012345.log
sarah: TL;DR numbers plz :)
anya: Short summary (p50 latency / tokens/sec / $ per 100k calls estimate):
- Embeddings (512 dims * synthetic batch=1 requests): L4 fp16 p50=22ms, tps=45 req/s, est cost= $2.1 per 100k. T4 fp16 p50=36ms, tps=28 req/s, est cost= $1.6 per 100k (lower hourly GPU cost), A10G fp16 p50=16ms, tps=62 req/s, est cost= $3.6 per 100k.
- Embeddings int8: L4 p50=19ms (+~15% perf), T4 p50=30ms, A10G p50=14ms. int8 cost reduces token compute ~20% for L4/A10G.
- Embeddings int4: unstable on T4 (OOM on long prefixes), L4/A10G ok but quality delta negligible vs int8.
- Small-chat (128 tokens, chat model variant): L4 fp16 p50=85ms (tokens/sec ~220), T4 fp16 p50=130ms (tokens/sec ~140), A10G fp50=54ms (tokens/sec ~340). int8 helps L4 a bit (p50 -> 72ms) but int4 causes occasional generation artifacts in 2% of eval prompts.
anya: Kernel note: triton fused-attn gives best perf for A10G on small-chat; L4 benefits more from cutlass int8 paths. T4 shows middling improvements because some custom kernels aren't supported on that microarch.
ben: Any regressions in quality from int8/int4? we care for small-chat more than embeddings.
anya: For embeddings int8/int4 eval (cos-sim on existing benchset) delta <0.2% in top-10 retrieval AUC. For small-chat, int8 delta ~0.5% BLEU-ish/lfu metric, int4 delta ~2.8% and shows repetition on certain system prompts. Recommend int8 for chat if cost-sensitive, avoid int4 unless we add post-quantization calibration + small regen filter.
dmitri: Region differences?
anya: Latency-wise A10G in us-west1 best. EU shows ~10-15% higher p50 due to instance flavors we used (A10G equivalent but network overlay). L4 in ap-southeast1 had slightly worse cooling throttling during long soak — T4 cheap in APAC but throughput lower.
sarah: Ops question — which to default for hosted API tiers? cheap tier -> T4 int8 for embeddings? mid-tier -> L4 int8? premium -> A10G fp16?
anya: My recommendation: embeddings: default L4 int8 in global pool (balance cost/perf) with fallback to T4 for overflow and A10G for latency-critical customers. small-chat: default A10G fp16 for latency SLOs, L4 int8 as cost-aware option; block int4 for chat in hosted until we fix artifacts.
ben: Any config/flag diffs we should add to rollout docs?
anya: Add kernel-policy presets: cheap (t4-compat), balanced (l4-int8-cutlass), low-latency (a10g-triton-fused). Also add quality gate for int4 flagged via eval-suite threshold (regen rate <1%).
dmitri: Can you paste the perf-run command used?
anya: Sure:
```
./run_bench.sh \
  --model redwood-small-chat-v1 \
  --gpu-pool l4,t4,a10g \
  --quant fp16,int8,int4 \
  --regions us-west1,eu-west1,ap-southeast1 \
  --kernel-policy auto,triton,cutlass \
  --duration 20m \
  --out /mnt/bench/1718012345.log
```
ml-bench-bot: artifacts uploaded: /artifacts/1718012345/summary.csv, /artifacts/1718012345/kernels.log
sarah: Awesome — can you push a short PR to docs with the recommended presets and the int4 hold rule? I'll queue comms for customers.
anya: Yep will do this afternoon. I'll attach the full CSV to the PR.
ben: Thanks team — super helpful. We'll sync in next infra sync to align node types. :thumbsup:
